## Problem / motivation
What are you trying to do that's hard or impossible today?

## Proposed solution
What you'd like to see. Be as specific as helpful (which panel section or
parameter, expected behavior, how the hardware originals handle it if relevant).

## Alternatives considered
Any workarounds you're using now, or other approaches.

## Additional context
Mock-ups, references to other synths/editors, links to manual pages, etc.
